name: sesamol
summary: Sesamol is a natural organic compound which is a component of sesame seeds and sesame oil, with anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, antidepressant and neuroprotective properties. It is a white crystalline solid that is a derivative of phenol. It is sparingly soluble in water, but miscible with most oils. It can be produced by organic synthesis from heliotropine.

pharmacology.text: Sesamol's molecular targets and mechanism of action, at least for its antidepressant-like effects, is found to be through the brain nerve growth factor (NGF) and endocannabinoid signalling under the regulatory drive of the CB1 receptors.

uses.text: It can be used in the synthesis of paroxetine. Alexander Shulgin used sesamol in his book PiHKAL to make MMDA-2.

summaryZh: 芝麻酚是苯酚的一種衍生物，呈白色結晶固體，是芝麻油的成分之一。它難溶於水，但可以和大多數油脂混合。

fact.en: Sesamol forms when sesame seeds are roasted and is part of what makes sesame oil keep so well, because it mops up the radicals that make oils go rancid.
fact.zh: 芝麻酚在芝麻烘焙時形成，也是芝麻油特別耐久放的原因之一，因為它會清除讓油脂酸敗的自由基。
fact.zhHans: 芝麻酚在芝麻烘焙时形成，也是芝麻油特别耐久放的原因之一，因为它会清除让油脂酸败的自由基。
